notes.title: non - The First Warp is a point and click adventure with 'genre-first time-manipulation'
notes.notes:
Any game that claims to have a "genre-first" will always raise some eyebrows and that's exactly what the developers of non - The First Warp are saying with it out now.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/08/non-the-first-warp-is-a-point-and-click-adventure-with-genre-first-time-manipulation
